title: Portal config
description: One schema for portal.base.yaml (product defaults) and tenants/<tenant>/portal.yaml (a tenant's overlay). Both are validated on boot; nothing is required here, so an overlay may name only what it changes. The merged config must also name product.name and a menu whose every entry has a label and a path, which the binary checks after the merge.

mode.description: What the tenant is run for (docs/design.md 39). dev: Invoke-Build Dev mints the admin dev-bootstrap, GET .../dev-token serves its token on 127.0.0.1, and the page shows an amber DEV MODE bar. demo: a blue DEMO bar and no shortcuts. prod: neither. Absent means prod. Separate from PORTAL_MODE, which hides the Designer.

theme.description: The shell's own settings. Node display stays in State and Theme nodes (docs/design.md 5).

wheelZoomSpeed.description: Scales the Canvas's mouse-wheel zoom step: 1.0 is the product's step.

feeds.description: Where cards are published (docs/design.md 40). An overlay overrides a feed by id, key by key, or adds one; the merged feeds each need kind and url, which the binary checks after the merge.

id.description: The feed's name: the {feed} of .../feeds/{feed}/push, and ui:feed:<id>.

url.description: oci: the registry and repository namespace (http://127.0.0.1:8201/cards). nuget: the v3 service index (http://127.0.0.1:8202/v3/index.json).

visibility.description: Recorded on the Feed node; not enforced in 0.6.0.

token_env.description: The environment variable holding the feed's API key, read at push time, never stored or served.

kind.description: The node Kind the page lists (Graph.Node's kind pattern).

screen.description: With view screen: the screen node drawn.
